SINGLE_HYPOTHESIS: In ProcessWideFp32CachedRows pass 1, free the residual staging slot right after the Add and prefetch the next tile's residual into it so the MTE2 load overlaps the square and reduce. The square goes into the x slot and the ReduceSum workspace is the unwritten tail of the value cache. Tiles whose tail is too small fall back to the original pattern. Same UB footprint. This is a staging-liveness change only: no new buffer pair, no arithmetic change, no dispatch change.
WHY_NOT_DUPLICATE: R31A V020 tried a related pass-1 overlap goal but via a DIFFERENT mechanism: it added a second staging pair (dual-slot kWideFp32CachedStageElems = tile/2) plus four event IDs, and correctness-FAILED (507035). V025 adds NO buffer pair and NO event IDs — it only reassigns the existing x/residual roles and uses the value tail as the reduce workspace, so the same-footprint liveness change is a distinct mechanism. V020 is retained as a failed revision and is not mixed in. V024 hoisted the pass-2 Muls (different pass). V021 moved the pass-2 MTE3 wait (sync placement, different pass). V022 changed the dispatch predicate. Cross-route: UB-LIVENESS-X owns buffer lifetime/aliasing as a design axis on its own parent code; this is a minimal same-footprint role flip in R31A's CachedRows. ASYNC-TRIPLE-X owns full MTE2/V/MTE3 triple overlap; this is one boundary (residual release) in one function. EPILOGUE-ARITH / STORE-EPILOGUE-X / SHAPE-TILING untouched. Full analysis in 研究/R31A/next-hypotheses.md H4 section.

MECHANISM_DETAIL.tailWorkspace_tiles: square into xBuf_, reduce workspace = valueLocal[col+valid] (unwritten tail, needs tail >= valid), residual staging freed after Add so the next tile's residual MTE2 prefetch overlaps the square and reduce. At D=32768 tiles at col=0,7680,15360 qualify (tail 25088/17408/9728 >= 7680).
MECHANISM_DETAIL.fallback_tiles: tiles whose tail < valid (at D=32768 col=23040 tail=2048, col=30720 tail=0) use the original pattern: square into residualBuf_, xBuf_ as workspace, one blanket SyncVToMTE2, no prefetch.
MECHANISM_DETAIL.prefetch_handoff: resPrefetched flag carries across iterations: a qualifying tile prefetches the next residual; the next tile consumes it in Add before any reuse. Transitions between qualifying and fallback tiles are safe because the prefetched residual is consumed by Add before residualBuf_ is overwritten.

PRECISION_RISK: None in the arithmetic: the same Add, Mul (square), and ReduceSum are performed on the same values. The only change is which buffer holds the square and where the reduce scratch lives. Correctness must still be verified end-to-end because the sync ordering changed.
